mapper.select: SELECT ct.id AS id, ct.task_no AS taskNo, ct.tenant_id AS tenantId, st.tenant_name AS tenantName, ct.service_id AS serviceId, ct.service_name AS serviceName, ct.source_number AS sourceNumber, ct.source_id AS sourceId, ct.customer_id AS customerId, ci.customer_name AS customerName, ct.company_id AS companyId, cc.company_name AS companyName, cc.tax_number AS taxNumber, cc.company_type AS companyType, ct.current_owner_user AS currentOwnerUser, ct.current_owner_user_name AS currentOwnerUserName, ct.owner_user AS ownerUser, ct.owner_user_name AS ownerUserName, ct.create_by AS createBy, ct.create_by_name AS createByName, ct.wish_finish_time AS wishFinishTime, ct.real_finish_time AS realFinishTime, ct.create_time AS createTime, ct.status AS status, ct.remark AS remark, ct.task_data AS taskData, ct.putup_reason AS putUpReason, ct.cancel_reason AS cancelReason FROM common_task ct LEFT JOIN customer_company cc ON ct.company_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ct.customer_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant st ON ct.tenant_id = st.id and st.deleted = 0 WHERE ct.deleted = 0 AND ct.id = #{id}
